calculation.description: At each date, rank assets by the negative deviation of their trailing three-session return from the cross-sectional median; positive values favor recent relative losers for reversal.
calculation.timing: Trailing return uses closes through the decision-date prior completed session; forward one-session return is validation target only.

validation.regime_notes: Validated across the full synthetic cross-asset history and multiple regimes; uncertainty is interpreted conservatively because the cross-section is 15 assets.
